title: Tennis match history of any player

playerUrls.title: Players (names or URLs)
playerUrls.description: Player names, e.g. "Jannik Sinner" or "Swiatek" (the best-known player of that name), or Flashscore player page URLs, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/player/sinner-jannik/6HdC3z4H/, to pick one exactly. You get every match of each, newest first.

players.title: Opponent name contains
players.description: Keep only matches against these opponents (name contains, case-insensitive), e.g. Alcaraz. Empty = every opponent.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.description: Keep matches on these surfaces. Empty = all. Matches without a surface (team ties) are dropped when this is set.

tournaments.title: Tournament name contains
tournaments.description: Keep matches whose tournament name or category contains any of these, case-insensitive, e.g. Beijing, US Open, W100, Challenger.

tours.title: Tours
tours.description: Keep only these tours. The default leaves out other = exhibitions (e.g. Six Kings Slam), juniors and the rest; empty = all.

matchType.title: Singles or doubles
matchType.description: singles (default), doubles (includes mixed doubles), or all (also team ties).

status.title: Status
status.description: finished (default: played matches, including retired, walkover and awarded), scheduled (the player's next matches), live, or all.

includeStatistics.title: Match statistics
includeStatistics.description: Serve and return statistics for matches that started: aces, double faults, 1st serve %, points won on 1st / 2nd serve, break points saved and converted, service and return games won, for the match and each set. Included in the base price.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum matches to return, counted after the filters. A long career has 1,000-1,500 singles matches.
